contexts.text: I then saw (the Spirits). Their faces were black, and they had a white bandage round the head, by which is signified that they regard Divine worship as black, and thus the Lord's Word as black, and useful only to keep the common people in the bond of conscience.
As outward things are unrolled, or unswathed, so do delights become more pleasant and happy...

Such spheres are as it were poisoned... and they are wont to examine them by means of bandages as it were, which are of a dull azure colour; as these disappear, the sphere is broken up. SE 3379. SE 3395.

(A crowd of adulterous Spirits from Gehenna) who appeared to me as if they were only one... they were swathed round with bandages, which they seemed to themselves to be removing, by which was signified that they wanted to remove hindrances. SE 4082.
The xiphoid cartilage... from which descends the fascia alba, which is the fulcrum of the muscles of the abdomen.
As swaddling clothes enwrap an infant... TCR 215.
He was girded with a band which flamed... with carbuncles and sapphires.

I then saw a face which was black, but there was a white bandage round the head... This signified those who regard the Lord's Word as black, and useful only to keep the common people in the bond of conscience, which was the white bandage round the head.

When these (Sirens) have been cast into Hell, these pupae are unswathed, and this... in a long course. They are also wont to roll themselves up in bandages... These bandages are their ideas... SE 4599.
When there is a connexion with anyone, it is represented by a bandage which he holds in his hand.

Ye shall find the Babe wrapped in swaddling-clothes, lying in a manger... It is said wrapped in swaddling-clothes, because swaddling-clothes = the first truths, which are the truths of innocence, and which are also the truths of Divine Love; for nakedness, when predicated of an infant, signifies the deprivation of truth. Hence it is evident why it was that it was said by the Angels, This shall be a sign unto you, ye shall find the Babe wrapped in swaddling-clothes, lying in a manger.
